messages:
maria-chen: Heads up — after the scheduled key rotation at 04:12 UTC we're getting a spike of 401s on the hosted API. Error rate ~6% for a subset of customers. Seeing signature_verification_failed in verifier logs. @alex-garcia @dave-ops

alex-garcia: On it. Are these true signature failures or some token expiry path? any common customer pattern?

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rotation job rotator-2 finished at 2026-03-17T04:12:23Z (status: success) :white_check_mark:

maria-chen: Example repro curl from a customer:

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_abc..." https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
x-auth-error: signature_verification_failed key_id=rot-2026-03
content-type: application/json

{"error":"invalid_signature","message":"signature verification failed"}
```

dave-ops: I'm seeing rotator wrote new key rot-2026-03 to KMS, but several verifier pods still show cached pubkey rot-2026-02. Propagation TTL on verifier cache probably didn't clear. Trying a manual cache purge on edge proxies and verifier pods now.

alex-garcia: Paste of verifier log where failure shows up: 
```
[04:13:05Z] verifier=verifier-3 level=warn evt=signature_check err="signature_verification_failed" key_id=rot-2026-03 src=auth-service shard=7
[04:13:05Z] verifier=verifier-3 level=debug evt=pubkey_lookup key_id=rot-2026-03 cache_hit=false
```

jen-support: Customer #7654 reporting sudden 401s post-rotation, they were on a heavy write pattern. I replied asking them to retry and that we're investigating. Any short mitigation we can offer?

dave-ops: Immediate mitigation: rolled back primary to rot-2026-02 at 04:28 UTC and started a targeted cache purge. Edge CDN invalidation issued for auth pubkey header. Traffic is trending back to normal but some clients still hit cached verifiers (expecting transient 401s for ~5-10m).

maria-chen: Thanks. I'll update the support ticket and post status. Action items:
- postmortem + timeline (owner: @alex-garcia)
- add cross-verifier sync check to rotation job before flipping primary
- add cache-purge step / healthcheck to rotation canary

alex-garcia: I'll open the PR for the rotation guard check and schedule a quick runbook update. :thumbsup:

maria-chen: Incident status: mitigated -> rollback applied and caches purged. Monitoring for residual 401s for 2h. Will file incident and link customer tickets.

infra-bot: incident-bot: incident created ID: INC-2026-0317-rot-401s

jen-support: Noted — I'll update customers and tag affected tickets.
